front: When was martial law declared in Poland?

back: 'Restructuring': Gorbachev's reform of the Soviet economy.

front: When were the partly free elections in Poland?
back: June 1989; Solidarity won almost every seat it could contest.

front: Why did the Pope's election help Solidarity?
back: It strengthened the Church as a source of Polish identity; his 1979 visit gave people confidence.

front: Why was Gorbachev's attitude to force decisive in 1989?
back: Without Soviet tanks, governments could not crush protest as in 1956 and 1968.
